🚲 【Best Electric Cargo Bike Under $4000】With a load capacity of up to 550 lbs, GT53 electric cargo bike features detachable front and rear racks, and a central basket with 2 cubic feet of space. The 20-inch automotive-grade fat tires, enhanced load-bearing aluminum alloy wheels, and 3.0mm thick spokes ensure durability and stability. It's perfect for daily commuting and rivals a cargo van.
🚲 【2000W Brushless Hub Motor】The 2000W peak brushless hub motor delivers superior climbing ability with 98NM torque, reaching speeds up to 31 mph in pure electric mode, and easily handles gradients up to 35 degrees. It also features 3X brighter LED headlights and taillights for enhanced visibility and safety during nighttime rides.
🚲 【1123WH Removable Battery with Dual Charging Ports】Travel up to 50 miles per charge in electric-only mode and up to 105 miles in pedal-assist mode (PAS). The durable 1123WH upgraded detachable battery with IP54 waterproof rating charges conveniently in 5-6 hours using two chargers (Note: only one charger included in the package).
🚲 【NFC Unlock/Dual Hydraulic Brakes/Robust Suspension】Equipped with the latest smart screen, unlock your bike with the included NFC card for added security. Dual hydraulic brakes, dual 180MM disc brake rotors, and EABS ensure safe braking during cargo transport. The high-strength aluminum front fork, high-performance fat tires, and high-resilience sponge seat provide a comfortable riding experience.
5⭐【Top Quality, Top Service】 90% pre-assembled with clear video, and we offer comprehensive customer support including phone support + 24/7 Email support(service@gyroorboard.com)
